purpose: Map the non-LPB/Matkator Sun Park owner, claimant, representative, Community and later Acosta Matos perimeter without collapsing ownership, litigation status, office, family relationship, corporate capacity or liability.
governing_boundaries: AP 89/2014 controls the seven JV 1260/2011 claimant-owners and the 18-bungalow finding within that case; it does not define the complete minority-owner universe.
The wider Montelanza/Molina perimeter comes from party pleadings, Community records and later ownership/corporate material and is not a judicial finding of collective wrongdoing.
Ownership, representation, attendance, voting, family relationship, corporate office, access activity and later title are different relationships.
Family or business membership does not transfer knowledge, intention, instruction, benefit or responsibility.
The 2022 Acosta Matos title/project layer cannot be projected backwards as proof of a common plan in 2011 or authority for earlier acts.
LPB, Matkator, CEXP, the Community of Owners and third-party units remain legally distinct.

source_hierarchy.meaning: Controlled judicial decision; binding only within its actual scope.
Filed record, testimony or court-controlled procedural material; proves role or what was stated, subject to scope.
Community meeting/attendance/power/vote record; authenticity, legal validity and authority remain separate questions.
Complaint, opposition or appeal; proves a party position, not the truth of the allegation.
Working ownership or continuity synthesis requiring title, Registry and date reconciliation.

judicial_core.proposition_es: La Audiencia Provincial identificó a siete demandantes/apelantes como propietarios de 18 bungalows.
judicial_core.proposition_en: The Provincial Court identified seven claimants/appellants as owners of 18 bungalows.
judicial_core.adverse_result: AP 89/2014 partially reversed first instance and ordered Monterecco Sun Park, S.L. evicted from the claimant-owned apartments within the case.
judicial_core.limit: The seven claimants are not treated as the whole residual-owner population, and no other owner is treated as an AP89 claimant without case-specific evidence.

layers.title_es: Núcleo judicial confirmado — siete propietarios demandantes / 18 bungalows
layers.title_en: Judicially confirmed core — seven claimant-owners / 18 bungalows
layers.limit_es: No equivale a todo el perímetro minoritario ni prueba un acuerdo común.
layers.limit_en: Not equivalent to the entire minority perimeter and not proof of a common agreement.

layers.title_es: Perímetro más amplio Montelanza/Molina — propietarios, sociedades y representados
layers.title_en: Wider Montelanza/Molina perimeter — owners, companies and represented interests
layers.limit_es: «Familia Molina/minoritarios» es un descriptor de parte, no una persona jurídica, un grupo penal ni prueba de conocimiento compartido.
layers.limit_en: “Molina family/minority owners” is a party-side descriptor, not a legal person, criminal group or proof of shared knowledge.

layers.title_es: 2011 — órgano comunitario, representación, deuda y voto
layers.title_en: 2011 — Community organ, representation, debt and voting
layers.limit_es: Poderes, convocatorias, coeficientes, deuda y derecho de voto requieren el original y la fecha; el registro no decide su validez.
layers.limit_en: Powers, notices, coefficients, debt and voting entitlement require the original record and date; this register does not decide validity.

layers.limit_es: La transcripción no sustituye poderes, hoja de encargo ni prueba de quién instruyó cada actuación.
layers.limit_en: The transcript does not replace powers, retainers or proof of who instructed each act.

layers.title_es: 2017–2018 — Pamalexsha, Comunidad, seguridad, acceso y CAM
layers.title_en: 2017–2018 — Pamalexsha, Community, security, access and CAM
layers.limit_es: Las declaraciones judiciales prueban lo declarado, no automáticamente la legalidad del cargo, la exactitud del relato o un acuerdo criminal.
layers.limit_en: Court statements prove what was stated, not automatically the legality of the office, accuracy of the account or a criminal agreement.

layers.title_es: 2022 — Acosta Matos, representación, proyecto y saldos deudores
layers.title_en: 2022 — Acosta Matos representation, project and debtor balances
layers.limit_es: Deben cerrarse sociedad exacta, NIF, poder, finca, coeficiente y voto; el título posterior no legitima retroactivamente actos anteriores.
layers.limit_en: Exact company, NIF, power, unit, coefficient and voting status must be closed; later title does not retroactively authorise earlier acts.

layers.title_es: Perímetro familiar/empresarial Acosta Matos — juntos visualmente, separados jurídicamente
layers.title_en: Acosta Matos family/business perimeter — visually clustered, legally separate
layers.distinction: PD-SP-P-0087 Gerardo Zacarías Acosta Matos is not PD-SP-P-0013 Gerardo Nicanor Acosta Armas.
layers.limit_es: Parentesco o pertenencia empresarial no transmite conocimiento, intención, instrucción, aprobación, beneficio o responsabilidad.
layers.limit_en: Family or business membership does not transfer knowledge, intention, instruction, approval, benefit or responsibility.

individualised_propositions.proposition_es: La reconstrucción de la parte denunciante atribuye a Celia Guillén Pérez una posición de voto específica en la junta de 2 de febrero de 2011.
individualised_propositions.proposition_en: The complainant-side reconstruction attributes a specific voting position to Celia Guillén Pérez at the 2 February 2011 meeting.
individualised_propositions.limit_es: Es una reconstrucción documentada de parte, no una conclusión judicial sobre intención o culpabilidad.
individualised_propositions.limit_en: This is a documented party reconstruction, not a judicial finding about intention or culpability.

individualised_propositions.proposition_es: El acta de 4 de febrero de 2022 lo sitúa presente y registra que, a su petición, se explicó el origen de saldos deudores.
individualised_propositions.proposition_en: The 4 February 2022 minutes place him present and record that, at his request, the origin of debtor balances was explained.
individualised_propositions.limit_es: Pedir una explicación no equivale a crear, verificar independientemente o aprobar originalmente la deuda.
individualised_propositions.limit_en: Requesting an explanation is not the same as creating, independently verifying or originally approving the debt.

p0_evidence_programme: Map the AP 89/2014 eighteen bungalows to certified finca identifiers and owner at each material date.
Reconstruct the complete 2008 post-transaction residual ownership perimeter unit by unit, preserving source-specific percentage denominators.
Trace every later acquisition by CAM/Acosta Matos or connected vehicles from the prior non-LPB/Matkator holders, including deed, consideration, payment and registration.
Authenticate the original February and June 2011 powers, attendance, debt schedules, coefficients and voting-entitlement records.
Obtain the certified complete DP 1132/2018 and Rollo 1010/2018 record and separate testimony from adjudicated findings.
Reconcile the 4 February 2022 record by exact Acosta Matos legal entity, NIF, representative, power, finca, coefficient and vote.
Resolve any 71-versus-72 residual-unit schedule discrepancy rather than forcing a denominator.
Connect each owner/claimant/representative edge to the platform recovery ledger without double counting ownership, income or damages.
